reason: On my entry-level salary, paying ₹99 for a tiny 100g tube makes no sense when Mother's Recipe gives double the quantity for less.
objection: ₹99 for 100g feels steep when a 200g pouch of Mother's Recipe is ₹70 and 500g Maggi is ₹72
would_change_my_mind: A starter student discount bringing it under ₹50 per tube.
